implementation.markdown: A substance, physical object or collection of objects that the laboratory considers a single discrete, uniquely identified unit that is the subject of one or more steps in the laboratory workflow. This is usually a part, a block or a slide.

concept.name: Probe / Material
concept.desc: Physisches Objekt oder Sammlung physischer Objekte, die als Einheit betrachtet werden und als Gegenstand einer Prozedur im Workflow gelten. Üblicherweise ein Material, ein Block oder ein Schnitt.

implementation.markdown: An organ or part of an organ or a collection of parts sent to the laboratory under a unique (sub-)order identifier for trimming, blocking, cutting and staining

concept.name: Material
concept.desc: Organ oder Organteil oder eine Sammlung derselben, die als Probe zur Bearbeitung und Begutachtung eingesandt werden.

implementation.markdown: Identifier of the part, issued by the LIS. It corresponds with the Order ID.

concept.name: Material-ID
concept.desc: ID des Einsendungsmaterials, kann identisch mit Fall-Nr. sein

implementation.markdown: A piece of tissue under a unique identifier resulting from trimming, embedded in paraffin or othe embedding media (usually FFPE ... Formalin-fixed, Paraffin-embedded).
Identifier of the paraffin block, issued by the LIS as work order ID. In most cases identical with a container ID of the tissue cassette.

concept.name: Block-ID
concept.desc: ID des Blocks, meistens identisch mit der ID der Kassette.

implementation.markdown: A section of tissue on a glass-slide, mounted in medium and covered by a cover plate, carrying a unique identifier, resulting from cutting from a block with subsequent staining procedure
Identifier of the slide, issued by the LIS. It corresponds with a Work order ID or a Specimen work order step ID

concept.name: Schnitt-ID
concept.desc: ID des Gewebsschnittes, meistens identisch mit ID des Objektträgers.

implementation.markdown: Lokalisation der Körperstelle, von der das Material stammt.

concept.name: Materialherkunft
concept.desc: Lokalisation der Körperstelle, von der das Material stammt.

implementation.markdown: Identification of the specimen, done by identifiers, issued by the LIS.

Identifier for the specimen, issued by the LIS.
These can be Part-ID, ID of the embedded tissue (so-called Block-ID), or ID of the sectioned and stained tissue (so-called Slide-ID). An ID of the sectioned, unstained tissue (Tissue section-ID) is usually not given by the LIS
ID of the parent specimen, issued by the LIS Each specimen has a pair of IDs, consisting of its own and of its parent. The relationship between both need not to be expressed by the ID syntax.

concept.name: Parent ID
concept.desc: ID der Elternprobe, von der die zu bearbeitende / zu untersuchende Probe stammt.

implementation.markdown: Physical object that touches and holds specimen. Those may be vessels, syringes, plastic bags etc., especially important are Paraffin blocks and Slides.

concept.name: Container
concept.desc: Probenbehälter im weitesten Sinn: Einsendungsgefäß, Gewebskassette, Paraffinblock, Objektträger etc.

terminologyAssociation.codeSystemName: Logical Observation Identifier Names and Codes

implementation.markdown: Identification of the container that holds the specimen. In practice the containers are the only physical entities that carry a human (and machine-) readable identifier. Blocks and Slides may hold more than one specimen, also from different sources!

concept.name: Container ID
concept.desc: Identifikation des Containers, kann von Proben-ID verschieden sein
